title: Micro priority log: ops gaps & launch hits — Jun 2025
quick_summary: One-page running tracker for small cross-team issues discovered during the mid-June feature push. Use this for daily standups and async handoffs. Prioritizes anything that is customer-visible or affects Dedicated/Private rollout flows.
content:
Header: ID | Item | Impact | Owner | Stakeholders | Due | Status | Effort | Blocker | Next action / notes

1 | Canary failover route mis-configured for canary-2 | High (customers see 504s during rollouts) | Miguel Torres (infra) | eng-serving-runtime, sre, product-hosted-api | 2025-06-20 | resolved -> monitor | high | root cause: route tag mismatch | Patch merged (PR#3123). Prod monitor added, follow-up: postmortem draft (INF-4982).

2 | Dedicated cluster autoscaler underestimates GPU demand on burst | High (throughput drop for Dedicated customers) | Priya Kapoor (platform-eng) | platform-engineering, infra, sales | 2025-06-25 | in_progress | high | CPU metrics feed lagging | Add second metric source (prom -> pushgateway), SRE to validate thresholds. Tentative fix branch: infra/autoscale-fix.

3 | Embedding batcher occasionally duplicates embeddings on retry | Medium (cost leakage) | Eliot Wang (observability) | embeddings-team, finance | 2025-06-30 | open | medium | retry-id dedupe missing for partial-acks | Propose idempotency token; quick mitigation: disable retry-on-5xx for embedding route. Need PM sign-off.

4 | Console: rollout UI shows stale model catalog after version pin | Low (confusing UX) | Sana Kapoor (product-hosted-api) | console, devexp | 2025-06-28 | in_progress | low | cache TTL too long | Short-term: add manual refresh button. Long-term: invalidate on deploy.

5 | Private deployment docs: KMS key rotation section incomplete | Medium (security/compliance risk for new customers) | Jamie Chen (company-ops) | private-deployments, security | 2025-07-05 | draft | medium | legal review pending | Draft updated, sending to security + legal (linked: CONFLUENCE:KMS-ROTATION-2025).

6 | Quick billing spike in test account after batching tweak | Medium (billing noise for trials) | Miguel Torres (infra) | finance, product-hosted-api | 2025-06-22 | resolved | low | rate-limit misconfiguration in staging | Reverted config, audit scheduled. Finance notified.

7 | Canary traffic split not applied for EU region due to missing route tag | High (EU rollout blocked) | Priya Kapoor (platform-eng) | release-engineering, infra | 2025-06-26 | blocked | medium | deployment pipeline missing region param | Release eng to add region flag; temp workaround: manual routing via infra console.

8 | Observability: slow traces for tokenization step on long inputs | Low (hard to reproduce) | Eliot Wang (observability) | serving-runtime, research | 2025-07-10 | open | low | sampling set too narrow | Increase sampling for prod long-tail inputs for 48h. Collect traces and share w/ research.

9 | GTM: customer-facing one-pager about Dedicated burst capacity out of date | Low (marketing collateral) | Sana Kapoor (product-hosted-api) | go-to-market, sales | 2025-06-24 | resolved | low | outdated numbers | Updated doc and posted to sales drive.

10 | Small regression in streaming latency after kernel swap | Medium (affects hosted SLO) | Miguel Torres (serving-runtime) | serving-runtime, release-engineering | 2025-06-29 | in_progress | medium | rollback candidate pending | Run A/B with previous kernel for 24h, collect percentile latencies. If >SLO, rollback.

Notes to self / process reminders:
- This file is intentionally compact — use ticket links above for deep dive.
- Daily owner note: owners, please update status line before 10:00 PT standup.
- Escalation rules: any item with Impact=High and Status!=resolved after 48h -> ping exec-ops and SRE lead.
- Cross-team sync scheduled every Tue 9am PT in #ops-sync; add one-off attendees as needed.
- Unresolved question: should embedding dedupe be handled in client SDKs or server-side? Add to architecture sync (ENG-ARCH Q3 backlog).

Quick metrics (auto-calculated in head):
- Total open items: 5
- High-impact open: 2
- Avg item age (days): ~6
- Estimated dev-days remaining: ~7.5

Next steps (short):
- Miguel: confirm kernel A/B data by 2025-06-27.
- Priya: temporary EU routing workaround by 2025-06-26.
- Eliot: start 48h trace sampling 2025-06-20.
- Jamie: nudge legal on KMS doc by 2025-06-23.

Unstructured brain-dump (notes to self):
- Might be worth a small playbook: "fast stripdown for Dedicated rollouts" — list exact checkboxes for infra, release, and product before canary. Keep minimal.
- Consider an internal lightweight SLA dashboard (one-pager) for launches — add to product-ops roadmap if we keep needing this tracker.
file_notes: Ad-hoc, created during mid-June rollout. Mainly for internal sync; not intended as final doc. If something becomes long-living, move to Confluence or create a formal postmortem.
